# Setup/Misc.

```{r}
#| echo: false

# Uncomment Librarys Required
library(tidyverse)
#library(readxl)
#library(readr)
#library(DBI)
#library(RSQLite)
#library(tidycensus)
#library(jsonlite)
#library(httr)
library(lubridate)
#library(rsample)
library(baguette)
library(dplyr)
library(GGally)
library(lubridate)
library(ranger)
library(readr)
library(rpart.plot)
library(skimr)
library(stringr)
library(tidymodels)

# Set seed for random data creation for replication
set.seed(123)

# Read in data
bike_data <- read_csv(
  "https://www4.stat.ncsu.edu/~online/datasets/SeoulBikeData.csv", 
  locale = locale(encoding = "latin1"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

#check for missing Data
colSums(is.na(bike_data))

#general Summary Stats
summary(bike_data)

#DATA Clean up/Variable Renaming
bike_data <- mutate(bike_data,
    Date = dmy(Date),
    Seasons = factor(Seasons),
    Holiday = factor(Holiday),
    `Functioning Day` = factor(`Functioning Day`)
  ) |>
  rename(
    date = Date,
    bike_count = `Rented Bike Count`,
    hour = Hour,
    temp = `Temperature(°C)`,
    humidity = `Humidity(%)`,
    wind_speed = `Wind speed (m/s)`,
    visibility = `Visibility (10m)`,
    dew_point_temp = `Dew point temperature(°C)`,
    solar_radiation = `Solar Radiation (MJ/m2)`,
    rainfall = `Rainfall(mm)`,
    snowfall = `Snowfall (cm)`,
    seasons = Seasons,
    holiday = Holiday,
    functioning_day = `Functioning Day`
  )

#Summary statistics of Bike rentals grouped by Functioning Day
bike_data |>
  group_by(functioning_day) |>
  summarise(
    count_obs = n(),
    mean_rentals = mean(bike_count),
    stddev_rentals = sd(bike_count),
    median_rentals = median(bike_count),
    min_rentals = min(bike_count),
    max_rentals = max(bike_count)
  )

#create subsetted dataset
bike_yes <- subset(bike_data, functioning_day == "Yes")

#create sums of days by date, seasons, and holiday variables
bike_subset1 <- bike_yes |>
                  group_by(date, seasons, holiday) |>
                    summarise(sum_bkcnt = sum(bike_count),
                               sum_rf = sum(rainfall),
                               sum_sf = sum(snowfall),
                               mean_tmp = mean(temp),
                               mean_humid = mean(humidity),
                               mean_winds = mean(wind_speed),
                               mean_vis = mean(visibility),
                               mean_dptmp = mean(dew_point_temp),
                               mean_slrad = mean(solar_radiation),
                              .groups = "drop"
                               )

#Summary stats (removing Date as it makes sense to analyze this date per season/holiday based on our set up. Date will likely be best used to measure changes over time).
bike_subset1 |>
  group_by(seasons, holiday) |>
  summarise(
    count_obs = n(),
    mean_rentals = mean(sum_bkcnt),
    stddev_rentals = sd(sum_bkcnt),
    median_rentals = median(sum_bkcnt),
    min_rentals = min(sum_bkcnt),
    max_rentals = max(sum_bkcnt)
  )
#Boxplot of bike count by seasons
ggplot(bike_subset1, aes(x = seasons, y = sum_bkcnt, fill = seasons)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7, show.legend = FALSE) + 
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Daily Bike Rental Counts Across Seasons",
    x = "Season",
    y = "Total Daily Rentals"
  )

#General bar plots
ggplot(bike_subset1, aes(x = seasons, y = sum_bkcnt, fill = holiday)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") + 
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    x = "Season",
    y = "Total Daily Rentals",
    fill = "Holiday status"
  )

#Bike Rentals over time Plot
ggplot(bike_subset1, aes(x = date, y = sum_bkcnt, color = seasons)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.8, size = 2) +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess", se = FALSE) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Daily Bike Rentals Over Time by Seasons",
    x = "Date",
    y = "Total Daily Rentals"
  )


#Numeric Summaries
numeric_vars <- bike_subset1 |>
  select(sum_bkcnt, starts_with("mean_")
  )

#Correlation matrix 
cor_matrix <- round(cor(numeric_vars), 4)
cor_matrix
```

## Task 1: Split the data

```{r}
#split data into 75/25 ratio
bike_split <- initial_split(
  bike_subset1,
  prop = 0.75,
  strata = seasons
)

#store splits as datasets
bike_train <- training(bike_split)
bike_test <- testing(bike_split)

#create 10 fold split of training data and fold
bike_fold <- vfold_cv(
  bike_train,
  v = 10,
  strata = seasons
)
```

## Task 2: Recipes

```{r}
#Recipe 1
recipe1 <- recipe(sum_bkcnt ~., data = bike_train) |>
            step_date(date, features = "dow", keep_original_cols = FALSE) |>
            step_mutate(
              day_type = factor(
                if_else(
                  date_dow %in% c("Sat", "Sun"),
                  "Weekend", "Weekday"
                )
              )
            ) |>
            step_rm(day_type) |>
            step_normalize(all_numeric_predictors()) |>
            step_dummy(all_nominal_predictors())

#Recipe 2
recipe2 <- recipe1 |>  
  step_interact( terms = ~ starts_with("seasons_"):starts_with("holiday_") +
                   starts_with("seasons_"):mean_tmp + mean_tmp:sum_rf)

#Recipe3
recipe3 <- recipe2 |>
  step_mutate(
    tmp_sq = mean_tmp^2,
    humid_sq = mean_humid^2
  )
```

## Task 3: Fit Models

```{r}
#set up engine
mlr_spec <- linear_reg() |>
  set_engine("lm")

#set up workflow functions
#model 1
workflow1 <- workflow() |>
  add_recipe(recipe1) |>
  add_model(mlr_spec)
#model 2
workflow2 <- workflow() |>
  add_recipe(recipe2) |>
  add_model(mlr_spec)

#model 3
workflow3 <- workflow() |>
  add_recipe(recipe3) |>
  add_model(mlr_spec)

#fit models
#model 1
fit1 <-  workflow1 |>
fit_resamples(bike_fold, 
              metrics = metric_set(rmse, mae))

#model 2
fit2 <-  workflow2 |>
  fit_resamples(bike_fold, 
                metrics = metric_set(rmse, mae))

#model 1
fit3 <-  workflow3 |>
  fit_resamples(bike_fold, 
                metrics = metric_set(rmse, mae))

#Collect Metrics
collect_metrics(fit1)
collect_metrics(fit2)
collect_metrics(fit3)
```
